cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You're Alex's friend too. Tell him alternating weekends at the allotment was a fair compromise. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then help him see my version as sharing the workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Could you explain that I changed the rota because I want us to stay friends?
